label: D1 fixation step in the first ~65 trials of an episode, strongest after an unrewarded trial or after choosing a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.9% of activations; never at GO, almost never at D2). Within D1 it fires on about 15% of steps, gated by episode time: rate peaks around trials 10-50 and drops to zero after trial ~75. It is also limited to a narrow band of the value head (about 7.1-7.7). Magnitude is largest on the first unrewarded D1 after a run of rewarded trials (the r0 cell in top windows is about 1.0), and it ramps up slowly over runs of rewarded a1/S1 trials. It is biased toward a1 and toward S1-good episodes. Predicate: D1 & ep_trial<65 & (prev_reward==0 | prev_action==1). Dev F1 0.49, recall 0.86, mass recall 0.91, precision 0.34. Adding the value band gives F1 0.51, so I left it out. Precision is low because whether it fires depends on slowly integrated hidden state that these discrete variables do not capture; it likely carries information in its magnitude. Uses only observed variables.
